run_f_gold: run f_gold to move all zeroes to the end of an array in-place
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple arrays to verify zeroes are moved to the end
review_f_gold: review f_gold which shifts non-zero elements forward then fills remaining positions with zeroes
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a single-pass two-pointer approach instead of two passes
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that moves zeroes to the end of an array preserving non-zero order
